vedic_reference.note: The name Urjas is derived from the Sanskrit root 'Ruj' which means 'to flow'. In Hinduism, the concept of Urja or vitality is associated with the divine energies that flow through the universe and sustain all life. The name is also associated with the god Rudra, who is known as the god of energy and vitality.
